entries.jp: オッケー　いいね\nオレの鼓動が\nイキっぱなしだ
entries.en: Okay, nice. My\nheartbeat's racing\nlike crazy.

entries.jp: 今日　この雷舞で\nレディたちのハートを\n奪ってあげよう
entries.en: Today, at this\nlive, I'll steal your\nhearts, ladies.

entries.jp: アーユーレディ？\n曲が始まれば\nもう後戻りはできない
entries.en:
Are you ready?
Once the song
starts, there's no
turning back.

entries.jp: このオレに\n全てを捧げる覚悟は\nできているか？
entries.en: Are you prepared\nto give\neverything to me?

entries.jp: オレは　今日ここで\nレディたちに会うために\n生まれてきた気がする……
entries.en:
I feel like I was
born to meet you
ladies here
today...

entries.jp: オッケー　Ｊ\n始めよう
entries.en: Okay, J. Let's\nstart.

entries.jp: その雷舞\n始めるのは待って\nもらうぜよ！
entries.en: Hold off on\nstartin' that live!

entries.jp: せっかくの雷舞じゃ！\n日本代表の志士として\n参加させてもらうぜよ！
entries.en:
A live this big! Let
us join in, as the
rebels
representin'
Japan!

entries.jp: みんなも構わんよな
entries.en: You folks don't\nmind, right?

entries.jp: おい　坂本龍馬だぜ\nよくもジュニアの前に\n顔を出せたもんだな
entries.en:
Hey, it's Ryoma
Sakamoto. He's
got some nerve
showing his face
in front of Junior.

entries.jp: ジュニア様の雷舞の\n邪魔をするなんて\n信じらんない
entries.en:
Getting in the
way of
Junior-sama's
live?
Unbelievable.

entries.jp: ひっこめー！\nあたしたちとジュニア様の\n神聖な舞台を汚さないで！
entries.en:
Get lost! Don't
defile the sacred
stage of
Junior-sama and
us girls!

entries.jp: お呼びじゃないんだよ！\n帰れ　帰れ
entries.en: Nobody asked for\nyou! Go home! Go\nhome!

entries.jp: こりゃまた　えらく\n嫌われたもんじゃな
entries.en: Well, would ya\nlook at that. They\nsure do hate us.

entries.jp: それも\n今の内だけです
entries.en: That won't last.

entries.jp: オレ様たちは志士だ\n音楽で黙らせてやろうぜ
entries.en:
Yours truly and
the boys are
rebels! Let's shut
'em up with our
music.

entries.jp: おう！　シンディの\n言う通りじゃ！
entries.en: Yeah! Shindy's got\nit right!

entries.jp: 龍ちゃん　晋ちゃん！\n五郎ちゃん！
entries.en: Ryo-chan!\nShin-chan!\nGoro-chan!

entries.jp: なんだ\nお登勢さんも\n来てたのかよ？
entries.en: What, Otose-san,\nyou came too?

entries.jp: あら\nなんだはないでしょ
entries.en: Oh my, don't you\n"what" me.

entries.jp: おう　お登勢やん\nお龍　おうの　幾松も
entries.en: Hey, Otose-yan!\nAnd Oryo, Ouno\nand Ikumatsu too!

entries.jp: みんな揃って\nじゅにあの雷舞か
entries.en: So you all came\ntogether for\nJunior's live, huh?

entries.jp: うう　龍ちゃんに\n言れると　さすがに\nココロが痛むわぁ
entries.en:
Oof... Hearing
that from you,
Ryo-chan, really
does sting my
heart.

entries.jp: 今日は日本中から\n贔屓が集ってるんだ\nしょうがないだろ
entries.en:
What do you
expect? Fans
came from all
over Japan today.

entries.jp: ジュニア様の雷舞……\n一瞬たりとも\n見逃せない……
entries.en:
Junior-sama's
live... I can't miss
a single moment
of it...

entries.jp: ぁたしもですぅ！
entries.en: Meee toooo!

entries.jp: これは負けられんぜよ
entries.en: Now I really can't\nlose this one!

entries.jp: 今日はわしのロックで\nみんなの心と　うまい\nピッツァを取り戻すぜよ！
entries.en:
Today my rock's
gonna win back
everybody's
hearts -- and that
tasty pizza too!

entries.jp: みんな　\n腰が抜けんように\n椅子にしがみついておけ！
entries.en:
Hang on to your
seats, everybody,
so ya don't fall
right outta 'em!

entries.jp: あら？　龍ちゃん\nちょっと　カッコよく\nなったんじゃない？
entries.en:
Oh? Ryo-chan,
haven't you
gotten a little
cooler, dear?

entries.jp: わははは　そういわれると\n照れくさいぜよ\nわはははは！
entries.en:
Wahaha! Hearin'
that sure makes
me bashful!
Wahahahaha!

entries.jp: お登勢さん\nあんたが誰の贔屓か\n思い出させてやるからな
entries.en:
Otose-san, we'll
remind you whose
fan you are, all
right?

entries.jp: 行きましょう\n全身に力がわいてきます\n膝が勝手に震えますよ
entries.en:
Let's go. I can feel
strength welling
up all through my
body. My knees
are trembling all
on their own.

entries.jp: 武者震いか\n特訓の……ゴホン\nいけそうだな　坂本
entries.en:
Trembling with
excitement, huh.
The training...
*ahem*. Looks like
you're ready,
Sakamoto.

entries.jp: ああ　わしはやる気満々\n気合いも充分っ！\n全開で行くぜよ
entries.en:
Yeah, I'm rarin' to
go and all fired
up! Full throttle, I
tell ya!

entries.jp: 龍馬達が舞台に躍り出ると\n期待に胸を膨らませた観客の\n大歓声が雷舞会場を包み込む
entries.en:
As Ryoma and the
others leapt onto
the stage, the
roaring cheers of
an expectant
crowd engulfed
the live venue.

entries.jp: オレに勝負を挑むとは\nそのグレイトな勇気は\n認めよう
entries.en:
You dare
challenge me? I'll
admit, that's some
GREAT courage.

entries.jp: おう　じゅにあ\n今日のわしらのロックは\nひと味違うぜよ！
entries.en:
Hey, Junior! Our
rock's got a whole
different flavor
today!

entries.jp: 上等なビッグマウスだ\nロックンローラーは\nそれでいい
entries.en:
A fine big mouth.
That's how a rock
'n' roller should
be.

entries.jp: ……で誰だ　お前は？
entries.en: ...So who are you?

entries.jp: オレ様たちのことを\n覚えてねえのかよ
entries.en:
You don't even
remember the
great Takasugi
and company!?

entries.jp: 男の顔と名前は\n家族とＪ以外\n覚えないみたいだよ
entries.en:
Looks like he
doesn't remember
men's faces or
names, except for
his family and J.

entries.jp: オウ　マイスイートハニー\nなぜナデシコは\nそっちにいる？
entries.en:
Oh, my sweet
honey! Why is
Nadeshiko
standing over
there?

entries.jp: なぜって　僕は元々\nこっち側の人間だし\n藁巻き一丁はごめんだし
entries.en:
Why? Well, I was
on this side to
begin with. And
I'd rather not
wear nothing but
a straw wrap.

entries.jp: ナデシコにワラを？\n言うわけがないだろう
entries.en:
Straw for
Nadeshiko? I
would never say
such a thing.

entries.jp: スケスケシルクのキモノを\nプレゼントしよう\nきっと気に入る
entries.en:
I'll give you a
see-through silk
kimono as a
present. You're
sure to love it.

entries.jp: あー親切にしてもらって\nいまさら言うのは\n心苦しいんだけど
entries.en:
Ah, you've been
so kind to me, so
it pains me to say
this now, but...

entries.jp: 不思議そうに首を傾げる\nジュニアに向けて\n一呼吸おくと――
entries.en:
He paused for a
breath, facing
Junior, who tilted
his head in
puzzlement--

entries.jp: 僕\n男だから
entries.en: I'm a guy.

entries.jp: ワッツ\n男？　ナデシコが男？\n笑えないジョークだ
entries.en:
What? A man?
Nadeshiko is a
man? That's not
funny.

entries.jp: 本当なんだけど……\n証拠を見る？
entries.en: It's true, though...\nWant to see the\nproof?

entries.jp: 沖田はジュニアに\n証拠を見せつけた
entries.en: Okita showed\nJunior the proof.

entries.jp: アンビリーバボー！\nだましたのか！
entries.en: Unbelievable! You\ntricked me!

entries.jp: あんたが勝手に女だと\n思い込んだんでしょ
entries.en:
You're the one
who decided I
was a woman all
on your own.

entries.jp: な　なんてことだ\nＪは　ナデシコが男だと\n気付いていたのか？
entries.en: Wh-what!? J, you\nknew Nadeshiko\nwas a man?

entries.jp: オレはとんでもない\n過ちを犯していた……
entries.en: I have made a\nterrible mistake...

entries.jp: 手を出さなかったのは\n不幸中のワザワイか
entries.en:
At least I never
laid a hand on
him. A blessing in
disgust.

entries.jp: 日本語が間違ってるが\nまあ　そうかもな
entries.en:
That's not how
the saying goes,
but... yeah, maybe
so.

entries.jp: かなり効いてますね\nジュニアはすっかり\n落ち込んでますよ
entries.en:
That hit him
hard. Junior is
completely
crushed.

entries.jp: うふふ　ジュニアの\n出鼻をくじくために\nここまで我慢してきたんだ
entries.en:
Hehe. I put up
with all of it this
long just to knock
Junior off his
stride.

entries.jp: 落ち込んでもらわなくちゃ\n困るよ
entries.en: He'd better be\ncrushed, or it was\nall for nothing.

entries.jp: 沖田は綺麗な顔して\n相変わらずどす黒いな\nジュニアに同情するぜ
entries.en:
Okita's got a
pretty face and a
pitch-black heart,
same as ever. I
almost feel sorry
for Junior.

entries.jp: いいだろう
entries.en: Very well.

entries.jp: 神をだました\n報いは受けてもらうぞ\nかかってこい
entries.en:
You deceived a
god, and you will
pay for it. Come
at me.

entries.jp: いきますよ！\n精一杯のロックを\nいえ　最高のロックを！
entries.en:
Here we go! With
all the rock we've
got -- no, with the
greatest rock of
all!

entries.jp: おう\n行くぜ！
entries.en: Yeah! Let's go!

entries.jp: 聴け　じゅにあ！\nわしの熱く滾る魂の\nロックを受け止めろ！
entries.en:
Listen up, Junior!
Take the rock of
my red-hot, boilin'
soul!
